issues.description: Retries are applied to all methods, so mutating POST requests can be duplicated after a retryable 5xx without idempotency protection.
httpx transport exceptions and timeouts are neither retried nor wrapped in LumenAPIError, leaking low-level failures to callers.
Resource IDs are interpolated into URLs without escaping, allowing query/path injection such as an ID containing '?limit=999'.
Retry-After parsing only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date header values.
Pagination assumes a valid JSON object with items and next_cursor, so malformed responses crash with generic exceptions.
Batch-create does not validate result count, duplicate indices, missing indices, or invalid statuses before returning sorted results.
BatchItemResult has no invariant checks, so a created result can lack a task or an error result can lack an error.
ReviewResult accepts any verdict value at runtime despite the public Literal type.
backoff_base and backoff_cap are not validated, allowing negative retry delays that can fail at runtime.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields, so supposedly immutable model instances can still be mutated.
Scripted mock responses bypass API-key validation, which can mask authorization behavior in tests.
The mock batch endpoint accepts malformed task specs and weakly validates required task fields, reducing contract fidelity.
Development tooling only declares pytest, with no linting, formatting, type-checking, or coverage enforcement for a typed client library.
